decision: Retain the original aqiu O cells after ordinary story-lock filtering. Remove the additional generic weekday filters for Aeon and Empress. Never generate meetings from a weekly pattern.
sourceScope: The aqiu day calendar is a third-party guide table, independently cross-checked with concrete Reload routes. It is not a raw extracted game table of NPC standing availability. 3DM and GamerSky repeat one Chinese route and are not counted as independent witnesses.

sources.claim: Aeon has 18 O cells; Empress has 30 O cells. Both include 1/21, which is separately removed by the existing story lock. Aeon has no O cell on 1/25; Empress has no Monday or Friday O cell from 12/25.
Aeon rank scenes occur on 1/12, 1/14 and 1/19. Empress RANK 9 occurs on Monday 12/21.

sources.author: Monomaru
sources.claim: The verified Reload route schedules Aeon RANK 2 on Tuesday 1/12, RANK 4 on Thursday 1/14, RANK 7 on Tuesday 1/19, and MAX on Tuesday 1/26. Empress RANK 4 is on Friday 12/4. It treats the 1/21 white-flower event separately.

A different all-MAX route schedules Empress RANK 3 on Monday 11/30, Aeon RANK 4 on Tuesday 1/19 and RANK 9 on Tuesday 1/26. Its optional 1/21 Aeon scene is explicitly displaced if the white-flower story event occurs.

sources.author: Robert Ramsey
sources.claim: Lists Aeon and Empress as available after school Monday through Saturday. Used to corroborate the weekday coverage, not to add any date absent from the O calendar.

unchanged: The existing 1/21 daytime story reservation remains.
Aeon remains absent on 1/25 and every Sunday or holiday without an O cell.
Empress remains absent on every Monday or Friday from 12/25 because the source O calendar already excludes them.
No invitation D cell becomes an ordinary meeting.
Other links, episode windows, story locks, thresholds and objective weights are unchanged.
